info.name: Cimbra API sandbox
info.description:
Generated from public/openapi.yaml. Import into Postman and set collection variables.

OpenAPI version 2026-09-01 · 194 operations.

Environment is sandbox: use cim_sk_test_ API keys. Live stays fail-closed until a production hostname and Go Live evidence exist.

item.name: collection tills

request.description:

item.name: Create a collection till with its own sandbox CVU

request.description:
Own Cimbra contract. Issues a sandbox CVU (000+9999) attributed to this till, not a second CVU of the collector account. Optional static QR of the same account, or issueStaticQr to mint a till-owned cimbra:qr:static:v1 that does not consume the account's one static QR. closedAmountOnly requires a pending sale order to pay that QR. presence is present or not_present attribution, not POS. Optional alias. Not a BIND caja, Coelsa CVU, EMVCo QR or POS.

operationId: createCollectionTill

Sandbox only. Does not move real funds or call competitor BaaS adapters.

item.name: Credit a collection till with a sandbox inbound cash-in

request.description:
Ledger cash-in to the collector account attributed to this till. Creates an inbound instant transfer with collectionTillId. When collection.till_credit maker/checker is enabled, returns 202 with a pending approval instead of settling immediately. Not a Coelsa credit.

operationId: creditCollectionTill

Sandbox only. Does not move real funds or call competitor BaaS adapters.

item.name: Disable a collection till and its sandbox CVU

request.description:
Irreversible. The CVU and alias stop resolving in the tenant directory. A new POST creates another till. Returns 200 JSON, including idempotent replay. Not a Coelsa disable.

operationId: disableCollectionTill

Sandbox only. Does not move real funds or call competitor BaaS adapters.

item.name: Issue the till-owned static QR of a collection till

request.description:
Own Cimbra contract. Mints one cimbra:qr:static:v1 owned by this till. The payload never changes. Paying it attributes the transfer to collectionTillId. If closedAmountOnly is true, a pending sale order is required. Not interoperable, EMVCo, PCT or a BIND caja QR.

operationId: issueCollectionTillStaticQr

Sandbox only. Does not move real funds or call competitor BaaS adapters.

Rails are BCRA, Coelsa, sponsor banks or schemes — never BIND, Dock, tapi, Pismo, Pomelo or Wibond. capitalPlan is the authorized USD 500 Gate 1 envelope; spending it does not set liveReady.

item.name: Collect a sandbox payment link

request.description:
internal debits another Cimbra account in the tenant. sandbox_inbound posts a cash-in against settlement. cimbra_qr pays the associated closed QR debt. cimbra_cvu credits the associated till CVU. amount is accepted only for cimbra_cvu; omit it to credit the remaining balance. Partial credits, several credits and overpayment are allowed until collectedMinor >= amountMinor. When collection.pay maker/checker is enabled, returns 202 with a pending approval instead of settling immediately. Card acquiring is not supported.

operationId: payPaymentLink

Sandbox only. Does not move real funds or call competitor BaaS adapters.

item.name: Create a sandbox collection link against an Argentine ARS account

request.description:
Payload format cimbra:link:v1 is not a card network checkout. Allowed methods are internal Cimbra accounts, sandbox inbound cash-in, Cimbra QR of an associated open debt (cimbra_qr) or the sandbox CVU of an associated collection till (cimbra_cvu). Optional items are checkout display only and do not change the amount to collect. Card, POS, hosted PCI checkout, successUrl/errorUrl and interoperable QR return 422 or 400. Only cimbra_cvu accepts partial credits, multiple credits or an amount above the remaining balance. QR and internal collection stay closed-amount.

operationId: createPaymentLink

Sandbox only. Does not move real funds or call competitor BaaS adapters.

item.name: List sandbox collection payment links

request.description:
operationId: listPaymentLinks

Sandbox only. Does not move real funds or call competitor BaaS adapters.

item.name: Refund a settled collection in full or in part with compensating ledger entries

request.description:
Omitting amount returns the remaining collected balance. amount refunds that ARS value from CVU credits in chronological order, or from the single closed-amount collection. creditId limits the refund to one CVU credit. A CVU link can reopen while collected remains below the original amount. Internal, QR and inbound stay closed after a partial refund. When collection.refund maker/checker is enabled, returns 202 with a pending approval. Not a card chargeback or BIND contracargo.

operationId: refundPaymentLink

Sandbox only. Does not move real funds or call competitor BaaS adapters.

item.name: Retrieve a collection payment link

request.description:
